workflow: A user supplies an unusually large valid input that exercises an optimized execution path.
The optimizer allocates a generated execution object while preparing that operation.
The generated object is not released after the optimized execution completes.
Leak detection reports the unreclaimed allocation instead of clean termination.
decision_reason: The bug materially matches the existing cluster: an optimization path allocates generated execution state and fails to release it, with leak detection exposing the omission. The large input and specific operation are triggering details rather than a distinct failure workflow.
